workspace_commit.description: Durable workspace-commit revision of this RUN's own checkpointed `workspace.commit` capability output (contract §4). Present only when the run's durable graph context holds that capability's exact successful output, read after the root row and its stored Creator are authorized; absent for a run with no such checkpoint (never synthesized from run state, file bytes or other context data). Survives restart without re-running the capability.
